items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He came to me, he said, you know, um, “Maybe we [should] switch jobs.”

ctx.x: Like that. Then … after that, I was … I was in a … I was actually, after that I was hired [by] Tokyo Jive, because Mister Matsui got … he had written some music that became a hit, and he was hired by a movie company. So I was his, you know, predecessor [successor] or whatever [chuckles]. And so … playing there, there was a pianist named Akimitsu [Yoshitaka].
